Showroom+ v2

Concept 9 · Direction: Showroom+ rebalanced: national, with Motocaddy, custom clubs and the members’ area as the three pillars

Owner feedback: fitting was over-weighted for a business that sells across the UK from one bay in Ringwood, and next year’s big pushes are the custom club builder and the members’ area. So v2 keeps Showroom+’s calm, light, one-idea-per-screen structure but changes what the ideas are. The hero names Motocaddy and ‘clubs built for you’ and says ‘delivering across the UK’, not Ringwood. A full dark section sells the online builder with its real steps and live model counts (33 drivers, 21 fairways, 22 hybrids and utility irons, 47 irons), an example build with real spec options, and three routes for anyone unsure of their specs. The members’ section becomes a preview of the members’ area itself, using the perks published on the current members page. Fitting moves to a compact ‘Near Ringwood? Get fitted for free’ band, positioned as one of the ways to get your specs for the builder.

Structural changes from the brief’s section order

Hero (three links: Motocaddy, build your clubs, join) → Motocaddy compare row → custom club builder (dark, the big push) → members’ area preview with the worked saving and both tiers → Shop the hole (replaces the brand grid: five shots from tee to green, each with buy-or-build) → near-Ringwood fitting band → rest of the shop → footer with a Members column.

Imagery and photography

Product cut-outs on light tiles; club heads on the dark builder section. One photo of the fitting bay for the near-Ringwood band. No staff portraits needed on the homepage any more (they move to the fitting page).

Headline copy

H1: “Motocaddy trolleys. Clubs built for you.”

Sections: “Which Motocaddy is right for you?” · “Build your clubs online.” · “Members get more.” · “Near Ringwood? Get fitted for free.”

Motion

As Showroom+: tiles fade up; builder type cards lift on hover; chips toggle in the example build.

Trade-offs

Does wellReads as a UK-wide specialist, not a local shop; gives the builder and the members’ area the weight they need for next year; fitting still visible as a genuine extra for people nearby; needs only one new photograph.
Weaker onLess human than v1 (no faces on the homepage); the members’ perks are numerous, so the preview must stay in step with the portal; builder counts must update from data, not by hand.
Build effortMedium: builder entry should read live counts from the builder’s data source; members’ preview needs a single source shared with the portal.
Photography neededLow: one shot of the fitting bay.
Suits bestUK-wide buyers of Motocaddy trolleys and custom clubs; members and would-be members.

EG monogram: As Showroom+: ‘EG’ in Schibsted Grotesk Bold, white on Evolution green (suggestion only; the mark itself isn’t being redesigned here).
